rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: split:refrain.1.1: p351-strip800.jpg, the refrain's first system (again atop p351-strip1600.jpg): the page prints all six of the refrain's repeated opening verbs with a capital, after commas too, so word 4 looks the same mid-line or opening a line. The header (p351-strip0.jpg) prints L.M. for the stanzas and only Ref for the refrain, so no metre fixes the refrain's lines. join:refrain.1.1: p351-strip800.jpg, the refrain's first system: line 2's opener is the repeated verb the page prints with a capital at every one of its six places, mid-line after a comma as well, so it reads the same joined. The header prints only Ref for the refrain, so no metre fixes its lines. join:refrain.1.2: p351-strip800.jpg ends the refrain's first system on a semicolon, and line 3's opener, first on the second system (p351-strip1600.jpg), is the repeated verb the page capitalizes at all six places, mid-line too. The header prints only Ref for the refrain, so no metre fixes its lines. split:refrain.1.3: p351-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's second system: word 4 of line 3 is the repeated verb the page prints with a capital at all six places, after commas too, so it looks the same mid-line or opening a line. The header (p351-strip0.jpg) prints only Ref for the refrain, so no metre fixes its lines. join:refrain.1.3: p351-strip1600.jpg, the refrain's second system: line 4's opener follows a comma and is the repeated verb the page capitalizes at all six places, mid-line too, so it reads the same joined. The header (p351-strip0.jpg) prints only Ref for the refrain, so no metre fixes its lines.
